newsitem.title: USA: Neogen files for 1.5 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Neogen files for 1.5 mln common shares.

text.p: Neogen Corp filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 1.5 million common shares.
The company said net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including potential acquisitions and working capital.
The offering will be made through Roney & Co and the Ohio Co. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 225,000 additional common shares.
The company said it will have 6,098,042 common shares outstanding after the offering.
